question: A free trade arrangement of the SAARC countries, the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA), came into force in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2006**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA)** is a free trade agreement signed by the **SAARC countries** to promote regional economic cooperation and reduce trade barriers.
 
• The agreement was signed during the **12th SAARC Summit**, held in **Islamabad, Pakistan**, in **January 2004**.
 
• The **SAFTA agreement officially came into force** on **1st January 2006**, aiming to enhance trade and economic integration among the member countries.
 
• The **SAARC countries** involved in this agreement include **India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, and Afghanistan**.
